description: React work a jsdom file leaves pending when it ends, on jest-environment-jsdom with one worker. Three shapes, a file each: an effect's cleanup that sets a timer reading `window` after RTL's cleanup unmounted the component (`unmount-timer`), an effect that sets a timer whose callback updates state (`state-timer`), and a root rendered outside `act`, which leaves React's scheduler a render and a passive-effect flush to run (`scheduler-pending`). `wait` is the smallest file, so it runs last, and its `beforeAll` waits 400 ms while the others' timers come due. Jest passes all four: the test's timers are the window's, and `window.close()` at teardown cancels them.
